subject: Subscription renewal — anchoring update & limited-lift proposal
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sagebyte.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal and limited lift option

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for a great conversation last week. Attached is our renewal proposal shaped for the usage profile you shared (see attachment: 20280602-sagebyte-proposal.pdf). High-level summary: 

- Term: 12 months starting Aug 1, 2028
- Commit: 2,000,000 token units (targeted uplift vs current run-rate)
- Pricing: tiered discount (10% off list for first 6 months on committed volumes, 7% thereafter)
- Onboarding credit: $50,000 credit to offset migration/ingestion costs applied at invoice 1
- Price hold: we can guarantee current effective rate for the first 90 days post-renewal on committed volume; overage pricing applies thereafter

If Sagebyte would prefer to cap the commit at 1.8M we can show a parallel model (small change to discount cadence). I want to avoid any cliffing for you — suggested next step is a 30-minute working session with procurement/finance and our ops lead to finalize cadence and PO timing. Are you available Tue 6/8 or Wed 6/9?

Couple of notes: procurement often asks for a longer price hold; we'll run that with finance but want to be explicit about the tradeoff on unit economics.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0193

Attachment: 20280602-sagebyte-proposal.pdf
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sagebyte.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Proc <maya.proc@sagebyte.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jun 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and limited lift option

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for sending this over. A few quick clarifications from our side before we schedule: 

1) Procurement/finance mindset — we need a clean 12-month price lock on committed volumes if we move to a committed model. A 90-day hold is hard for leadership to justify.
2) Commit sizing — our forecast supports ~1.8M tokens reliably (we still expect seasonality). Can you show the delta versus 2.0M and the impact on discounts/credits?
3) Security/compliance — SOC2 artifacts and data retention wording are gating items for our legal team. Who is the best security contact on your side?

Maya (cc) will lead the PO timing — FYI we run purchasing cycles the week of 6/20, would need final paperwork to hit that window.

If you can send an updated cost model and point person for security I’ll loop legal.

Appreciate it,
Alex Chen
Head of Cloud Platform | Sagebyte Inc.
alex.chen@sagebyte.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sagebyte.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Jun 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and limited lift option

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the clarity. Per your three points: 

1) Price hold — I can confirm we can extend the price hold to 12 months on committed volumes, provided we lock a committed floor (we propose 1.8M as the floor in the order form). Finance will need the final PO cadence to support the credit amortization.

2) Commit sizing / delta — attached is a short cost model (attachment: cost-model-v2.xlsx) that shows 1.8M vs 2.0M and unit price impact. Short summary: moving from 2.0M->1.8M reduces the incremental discount by ~1.5 percentage points over the term; to keep effective economics we propose increasing the onboarding credit to $60k if you prefer the 1.8M floor.

3) Security contact — looping Lauren (cc) in-house counsel and our security lead (can introduce to your legal/security team if needed). Lauren, do you want to handle the SOC2/retention notes directly or should I make a formal intro to our security team?

Proposed meeting: Wed 06/08 10:00am PT (30 min) — will include Ben to confirm finance treatment of the credit and I’ll bring the updated order form. Does that time work?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: cost-model-v2.xlsx
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sagebyte.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Proc <maya.proc@sagebyte.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and limited lift option

Soojin / Ben / Lauren —

Thanks for the model and for scheduling — meeting went well and procurement confirms they can hit the 6/20 PO window provided the order form reflects: 

- Commit floor: 1.8M token units (annual)
- Price hold: 12 months on committed unit rate
- Onboarding credit: $60,000 applied at invoice 1
- Overage: standard pay-as-you-go rates, with alerting at 80% of commit

Attached is our redlined SOW with two small language asks around data retention and audit evidence (attachment: Sagebyte_SOW_redline.docx). Legal will expect those edits to be acknowledged.

If Redwood can update the order form and send the DocuSign link by 6/14 we can issue the PO on 6/20.

—Alex

Attachment: Sagebyte_SOW_redline.docx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sagebyte.com>, Maya Proc <maya.proc@sagebyte.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final order form and next steps (Sagebyte renewal)

Alex / Maya —

Thanks — we incorporated Sagebyte's redlines and have locked the terms your procurement requested. Summary of agreed commercials (Order Form RDW-2028-095 attached):

- Term: 12 months starting 2028-08-01
- Commit: 1,800,000 token units (annual floor)
- Pricing: committed unit rate locked for 12 months on floor volume
- Onboarding credit: $60,000 applied to invoice 1
- Overage: standard pay-as-you-go; alerts at 80% utilization
- Security artifacts: Lauren will provide SOC2 and retention language confirmation to your counsel by 6/18

Next steps: 
1) Order form attached (20280615-sagebyte-orderform.pdf) — please confirm the contact and billing address.
2) DocuSign envelope will be sent by EOD 6/15 (link below), please route to the appropriate signer.
3) Once signed, expect onboarding kickoff within 10 business days.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-1234-SAGEBYTE

If you want a single consolidated PDF with the updated SOW + order form for procurement, reply and I’ll send it now.

Thanks again — looking forward to working together at scale.

Best,
Soojin Lee
